result.summary: The home screen has several layout overflow problems: category chips, restaurant cards, and a restaurant name are clipped, and the last popular listing is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row (Trattoria Piccol...) is clipped on the right, cutting off both the image and the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/insets to the carousel so the last visible card is fully on-screen, or show a peek of the next card without clipping text.

issues.description: The 'Healthy' category chip is cut off at the right edge of the screen, so the filter row looks unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Inset the chip scroller from the screen edges or fade the overflow so chips aren’t hard-clipped.

issues.description: The bottom popular restaurant card is cropped by the tab bar, so the listing feels incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content so cards sit fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated without an ellipsis or wrapping.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles or add an ellipsis so names aren’t abruptly cut.
